csv_project_name: As Needed Coastal Engineering and Consulting Services
csv_scope_of_work: Coastal Engineering and Consulting Services on an as-needed basis for miscellaneous projects located throughout Jefferson Parish for the Department of Coastal Management Specific scope of coastal engineering consulting services may include civil, hydraulic, hydrologic, environmental, mapping and CAD support. Work may include planning, permitting, design, bidding and construction administration and related supplemental services on an as-needed basis for projects located throughout the Parish as selected by the Parish Council. This scope for coastal restoration and protection services includes but is not limited to marsh and ridge restoration, shoreline stabilization and protection, beneficial use of dredge material, living shoreline design, hydrologic and hydraulic modeling, design analysis and reports, biological and environmental assessments of wetlands, technical evaluations, cost estimates, opinions of probable construction cost and field investigation
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Construction/Project Management, Cost Estimating, Planning/Master Planning, Biological Studies/Natural Resources, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Hydrology/Hydraulics

services: Coastal engineering and consulting services on an as-needed basis, including civil, hydraulic, hydrologic, environmental, mapping/CAD, planning, permitting, design, bidding, construction administration, geotechnical engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, cost estimating, master planning, biological studies, and environmental engineering/planning/design.
relevance_explanation:
- Framework-style as-needed consulting contract without a defined structural project.
- Focus is coastal/environmental engineering, hydrology, wetlands, and shoreline restoration rather than bridges or complex building structures.
- Includes planning and consulting disciplines that are outside sbp's core target areas.
- No identifiable long-span, lightweight, architecturally demanding, or special structural component.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated. The notice is for an as-needed consulting services contract covering multiple miscellaneous coastal projects over 36 months, so no realistic single construction cost can be derived from the provided information.
fee_explanation: No fee or contract value is stated. The procurement is an as-needed multi-project consulting contract, so a realistic sbp fee cannot be determined from the provided information.
references_qualifications: Disciplines requested include civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, construction/project management, cost estimating, planning/master planning, biological studies/natural resources, environmental engineering/planning/design, and hydrology/hydraulics.
